result_model, result_unique, result_denotation and result_failure require a Result whose start is the valid initial state. Arbitrary debug outcomes do not receive these claims.
Proof/type controls and fixture contrasts are explicitly distinguished from production runtime oracle kills.

The four organizing layers are operationally preserved: canonical finite function presentations and admitted reads; tagged occurrence multiplicity and additive destination collection; strict Option partial interpretation before collection; monotone publication and legal typed execution paths. No abstract Cat/Functor/Kan machinery is invented.
Selector completeness is for every supplied complete schedule and arbitrary Running state: select_none_iff identifies absence of any existing Step; Event.legal_step certifies every selected effect.
Publication payload equality, pending membership, exact destination-fiber barriers, no overwrite, retained failure snapshot, and actual missing-read addresses are preserved.

Whole-store completion and budget cover all defined coordinates, including nonoutputs and unwritten fibers. Tensor-level validation handles omitted empty inputs independently of address-level vacuity.
Successful schedule independence concerns the entire final Store; no claim is made that failures, diagnostics, traces, or validation priority are schedule-independent.

The approved endpoint supplies a complete schedule and coordinate ranks on a directly admitted exact-rational core. Automatic builders/checkers, source/backend correspondence, general cyclic solving, and heterogeneous non-additive input runtime coverage remain explicitly outside this milestone.

Current four-task manifest reconciliation and unmodified-wrapper controller verification supersede explicitly historical three-task/discovery/routing receipts; no finding is raised for those resolved matters.

Controller build, mutation, restoration, and axiom-list facts are accepted as supplied, not independently rerun. Acknowledged linter warnings and unavailable telemetry are not silently treated as clean warnings or zero token usage.
No package, production source, replay, main checkout, or repository metadata was edited. Only this requested review artifact was created and updated.
